gold_points: Operating income decreased 64% mainly due to global volume declines
Partially offset by yield improvement and lower operating expenses
Cost cuts: reduced flight hours, parked/retired aircraft, route consolidation, sort closures
Cost reductions lagged volume declines, so expenses stayed high relative to demand
